nodes.description: Hodgkin lymphoma is characterized by clonal Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that derive from pre-apoptotic germinal center B cells and survive via aberrant NF-kappaB signaling.

evidence.snippet: HRS cells in nearly all cases of HL derive from B cells, and only rarely from T cells.

Notably, the pattern of somatic mutations in their rearranged immunoglobulin V genes suggests that they are derived from pre-apoptotic germinal center B cells. The pathogenesis of HL is still largely unresolved, but it is now clear that aberrant activation of several signalling pathways (such as the NFkappaB pathway) is of key importance for HRS cell survival.
